meta.title: feat: optimize supabase start in CI with Docker caching and service exclusion
meta.body_summary: Add Docker image caching and exclude unnecessary Supabase services in CI workflows to reduce supabase start time from ~1:40 to ~0:40 minutes.

perf_labels.notes: Devin CI optimization; frontend-ci failed due to missing gotrue service; human fix not merged; PR closed without performance evidence.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 16 changed lines, this is a tiny edit by absolute volume, fitting a small-step infrastructure PR. It was closed due to CI failure and lack of evidence, which is consistent with the negligible change size that could not demonstrate claimed performance improvement.

review_details.concern_detail: Frontend CI failed because extract-supabase-anon-key.sh could not find the anon key after service exclusions; qodo-merge bot also flagged exclusion of postgrest and postgres-meta as potentially breaking database tests.
review_details.performance_claim: Reduce supabase start time from ~1:40 to ~0:40 minutes (~60% improvement).
review_details.rejection_signals: CI failure, missing performance measurement, PR converted to draft multiple times and eventually closed without merge.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: CI configuration changes require precise knowledge of service dependencies; initial implementation broke critical anon key extraction, requiring human intervention, and still lacked validation of performance claims.

detection_detail.code_reading: No human code review recorded; bots provided automated analysis of service exclusion risks.
detection_detail.ci_auto: GitHub Actions frontend-ci failed on extract-supabase-anon-key.sh; qodo-merge bot reported the failure and suggested cache key improvement.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: Performance claim based on external GitHub issue comment; no before/after timing measurement in PR, and CI failure prevented any verification.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: Human maintainer added a fix commit to re-enable gotrue service, but PR remained in draft and was closed without further attempts to merge.

core_change_summary.description: Added ScribeMD/docker-cache@0.5.0 step to cache Docker images in both CI workflows and modified supabase start command to exclude certain services via -x flag; later re-enabled gotrue service to fix anon key extraction.
change_trajectory: Initial commit (40784446): add Docker caching and exclude services (realtime, storage-api, imgproxy, kong, mailpit, postgrest, postgres-meta, studio, edge-runtime, logflare, vector, supavisor).
Fix commit (20df640): remove gotrue from exclusion list to allow extract-supabase-anon-key.sh to generate JWT keys.

review_signals.summary: Excluding postgrest and postgres-meta may break tests that need REST API or metadata; suggests caching key improvement.
frontend-ci failed: extract-supabase-anon-key.sh could not extract anon key; environment variable warnings.
review_signals.action_taken: Human maintained re-enabled gotrue service but CI outcome ultimately not resolved.

review_signals.summary: Warning: no changeset added; merging will not cause version bumps.

collaboration_trajectory: Devin opened PR with CI caching and service exclusion.
Frontend CI immediately failed on anon key extraction, reported by qodo-merge bot.
Maintainer force-pushed and merged baseline; then committed a fix enabling gotrue service (generated with Claude Code).
PR was converted to draft multiple times, received bot code suggestions, and was closed after ~74.6 hours without human review or merge.
